# Contributing

Thanks for wanting to help make Bitty Buddies better! 💚

## We don't accept code contributions

Bitty Buddies is **view-only**: the code is public to read, but all rights are reserved (see [LICENSE](../LICENSE)). That means we can't accept pull requests, forks or re-uploads, and please don't build or share your own copies.

## Ways you can help

- **Found a bug?** Use **Report a problem…** in the app's tray menu, or open a [bug report](../../issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- **Got an idea for a buddy, build or feature?** Post it in `#ideas` on our [Discord](https://discord.gg/aCHyjABJG7). The best ones end up on the roadmap.
- **Made fan art or a cool desktop setup?** Share it in `#fan-art` or `#show-your-desktop`. We credit any fan art we share.
- **Found a security problem?** Please don't post it publicly. See our [security policy](SECURITY.md).

Everyone taking part follows our [code of conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
